transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, August 18. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. No new strikes, no peace deal: What Donald Trump's 'low-key' Iran strategy means. The United States is employing a low-key strategy against Iran after a deadline expired. Economic pressure and diplomacy are now the primary tools being utilized. The US is maintaining sanctions and a naval blockade to influence Tehran. This approach aims to avoid immediate military escalation while seeking concessions. Nitin's 'Nabin' team: BJP hits reset button with eye on UP and 'Mission 2029'. The Bharatiya Janata Party has unveiled its dynamic new national team of office-bearers, strategically assembled to tackle both the upcoming assembly elections and the 2029 Lok Sabha contest. This diverse lineup features a mix of seasoned politicians and fresh talent, representing various regions. Some notable figures are making returns, while others have been sidelined, highlighting the party's commitment to revitalizing its organizational framework for future challenges. BWF Worlds: Ayush Shetty stuns World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi; India 5-0 on Day 1. Ayush Shetty produced the biggest win of his career on Day 1 at the BWF World Championships, stunning top seed and defending champion Shi Yu Qi in a thrilling contest. Led by the young Indian's heroics and PV Sindhu's comfortable win, India made a perfect 5-0 start on the opening day of the tournament in New Delhi. I-Day terror plot foiled: ISI-backed ring busted, 253 operatives held across 14 states. Shahzad Bhatti Gang's Terror Plans Foiled US student wins award for geometry breakthrough: How it can change modern medicine. Connor Hill won first place at the 2026 Regeneron Science Talent Search competition. His research classified noble polyhedra, identifying two infinite families and 146 isolated examples. Hill translated a geometric problem into a finite algebraic one for a complete classification. This method of reducing complexity is vital for modern biology and drug discovery. In boost to Taliban ties, India joins in with victory day celebrations. 2 Officials Attend Event At Embassy 100 days of TVK govt: CM Vijay defines priorities, but his real test begins now. Tamil Nadu's new Chief Minister Vijay's government has completed its first hundred days. The administration has focused heavily on welfare programs and social initiatives. Significant investment commitments have also been secured for the state's development. The government has implemented measures to address women's safety and curb drug use. 'Huge victory for Jharkhand': Mahto ends hunger strike after Soren govt accepts demands. NEW DELHI: Student leader Devendra Nath Mahto on Monday late night ended his 16-day hunger strike after the Jharkhand government announced the cancellation of the JSSC-CGL examination and all examinations conducted by TDPL, calling the decision a "huge victory for Jharkhand". California student raises over $90,000 after launching pickleball fundraiser. Olivia Shekou has successfully generated over ninety thousand dollars through her innovative sports philanthropy platform, known as Netting Miracles. Her initiative empowers students to spearhead fundraising events. Currently, she is gearing up for an exciting new fundraiser aimed at helping women and children in Uganda, scheduled to take place at Flyte Racquet Club in San Rafael. Her platform has now broadened its support across seventeen states, backing various charitable causes. New Zealand teacher and students turn coastal paddock into native habitat. Retired teacher Janet Pottinger spent 29 years helping Buller High School students restore native vegetation at Tauranga Bay and Cape Foulwind in New Zealand. Since 1997, around 2,800 students have planted 12,425 native plants across 108 trips. The project has transformed former grassland into habitat supporting birds, seals, lizards and other native wildlife. Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes a 'vacation request' to employees for this month. Accenture's CEO, Julie Sweet, has requested that employees delay their vacation in August. This temporary policy adjustment is designed to bolster staff presence as the company approaches the end of its financial year. Following disappointing quarterly results and a forecasted drop in revenue, Accenture is permitting employees to carry over unused vacation days into the next fiscal year to help enhance fourth-quarter outputs and revenue generation.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. 3,500 App-Based Taxis To Go Off Roads For Two Days From August 18 In Bhopal. Around 3,500 app-based taxis will remain off roads for two days from August 18 as drivers demand government-fixed fares. MP's Rhino Dream Hits Roadblock As Assam Declines Transfer, State Eyes Other Zoos. Madhya Pradesh's plan to bring a rhinoceros from Assam has hit a roadblock after Assam declined the transfer, citing the unavailability of a suitable zoo rhino. Bhopal Municipal Corporation Makes Credibility Verification Mandatory For Building Permissions. The BMC has made credibility verification of applicants mandatory before approving building plans for houses, commercial complexes and multi-storey buildings. MP Schools To Get Up To rupees 1 Lakh Annual Grant Based On Student Strength. Madhya Pradesh schools will receive annual grants based on student strength, with allocations ranging from rupees 10,000 for schools having up to 30 students to rupees 1 lakh for those with more than 1,000 students. Road accidents claims two lives in Bhopal. Leopard Skins, Traps, NGO: Curious Poaching Case Emerges In Madhya Pradesh. 13 Devotees Injured Amid Crowd Surge Outside Mahakaleshwar Temple On Nag Panchami In MP's Ujjain. Thirteen devotees were injured after crowd pressure triggered panic outside the Mahakaleshwar Temple on Nag Panchami. Bhopal police arrest five, including three minors, in alleged organ trafficking murder plot. LiveLaw Madhya Pradesh High Court Weekly Roundup: August 10. NGT Hears Plaint Of Public Health Risk From 'Informal' E-Waste Disposal In Bhopal, Redirects Case To Central Zone Bench. Bhopal teen lured with ' rupees 2 crore for organ donation' promise, killed. Bhopal Diary Twisha Sharma case report on August 17. 2 men injured in separate attacks in Bhopal. Bhopal on hold: Private taxis go off road in two-day strike. Nursing students protest 'yrs of uncertainty' over exams and degrees. 16-year-old girl drowns in nullah in Berasia. 30 percent of MP's GIS Investment proposals near ground-level implementation: CM Yadav. Female bartender stabbed to death during argument, accused colleague held.

Rupee weakens, bond yields harden as RBI shuts FCNR(B) swap window early. The rupee settled at 95.61 per dollar, while the benchmark 10-year government bond yield rose to 6.81 per cent as the RBI's move raised concerns over dollar inflows Stocks, dollar fall after weak data; yields rise. After weeks of shaky ground, artificial intelligence related stocks are on the rise again. Today, we take a look at what Elon Musk's post on growth of AI indicates about whether this upward trend is likely to continue. Horizon Industrial Parks IPO gets 14 percent subscription on first day of bidding. The initial public offering of Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd received 14 per cent subscription on the first day of bidding on Monday. The company's IPO received bids for 3,52,85,000 shares against 25,13,56,273 shares on offer, according to NSE data. The category for retail investors received 19 per cent subscription. The quota for Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) was subscribed 18 per cent and that of non-institutional investors 3 per cent. This small-cap ethanol stock to be in focus on Tuesday after additional supply order from OMCs. Modi Naturals is expected to attract investor attention following an ethanol order of 1.98 crore litres valued at rupees 140 crore, adding to a previous rupees 400 crore contract. Large currency speculators slightly reduce net short position in Pound futures market. Large currency speculators slightly decreased net shorts in Pound futures market, according to the latest Commitment of Traders (COT) data released by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). The non-commercial futures contracts of Pound futures, traded by large speculators and hedge funds, totaled a net short position of 56221 contracts in the data reported through August 11 2026. This was a weekly decrease of 1593 net short contracts. Bitcoin ETFs suffer biggest outflows since June as crypto sentiment weakens. The 13 spot Bitcoin ETFs registered combined net withdrawals of $389.7 million during the week ended August 10, compared with $853.5 million of inflows in the previous week INR settles lower amid muted equities and elevated oil prices. The Indian rupee depreciated 19 paise to close at 95.61 (provisional) against the US dollar on Monday, amid weak domestic equity markets and a surge in crude oil prices. The USD/INR pair is likely to trade with a slight negative bias, pressured by the delay in the deal between the US and Iran, rising crude oil prices and broader dollar support. Moreover, investors' sentiment turned cautious after the Reserve Bank of India on August 14 said that its swap facility for FCNR (B) deposits will be available only for deposits mobilised till August 31. Indian shares ended Monday's session lower as investors digested weak economic data from the U.S., Japan and China, and kept a close eye on geopolitical developments in the Middle East, adding pressure on rupee. Yes Bank eyes dollar bond market after six-year hiatus, arrangers appointed: Why now?. Yes Bank has appointed arrangers for a potential dollar bond issue and plans to sell a benchmark-sized three-year US dollar-denominated note. Stanley Lifestyles appoints Sudhir Iyer as Group Chief Financial Officer. Sudhir joins Stanley Lifestyles from Revathi Equipment (Dalmia Group), where he served as Group CFO and Vice President, leading financial strategy, business expansion and transformation initiatives. Prior to this, he held leadership positions at Goenka International and senior finance roles at Arvind Lifestyle Brands, where he worked closely with business leadership on financial performance, strategic decision-making and business growth. Axis Bank looks beyond loans to win corp wallets. Axis Bank is broadening its corporate banking services beyond just lending. Paytm promoter entity Resilient Asset Management to sell up to 4.98 percent stake. One97 Communications, parent of Paytm, announced a filing revealing that Resilient Asset Management, owned by CEO Vijay Shekhar Sharma, intends to sell up to 4.98 percent of its stake. Unemployment rate dropped to 5.1 percent in Jul-26 from 5.5 percent in previous month. The overall Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for persons aged 15 years and above increased to 55.4 percent in July, 2026, from 54.4 percent in June, 2026. After declining from March to May, 2026 and remaining unchanged in June, 2026, the overall LFPR increased in July, 2026. The same trend was also observed in rural areas, where the LFPR for persons aged 15 years and above increased to 58.0 percent in July, 2026, from 56.6 percent in June, 2026, registering an increase of 1.4 percentage points. In urban areas, LFPR increased marginally, from 50.1 percent in June, 2026 to 50.4 percent in July, 2026. Nabin's BJP team: Fresh faces and heavyweights. On Monday, the BJP revealed a revamped team showcasing significant changes. Sunshine Pictures raises rupees 85 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO launch on Tuesday. Sunshine Pictures raised rupees 84.64 crore from anchor investors for its IPO. The public offering includes a fresh issue of 4.8 million shares at rupees 342-360 each. 50 percent of shares are reserved for QIBs, with allocations finalized by August 21, and listings on August 25. Horizon Industrial Parks (HIPL) IPO subscribed 14 percent. The offer received bids for 3.52 crore shares as against 25.13 crore shares on offer. ICRA sees India GDP growth at 7 percent in Q1 FY27. India's GDP growth forecast stands at seven percent for the April-June quarter, marking a four-quarter low and a slowdown from prior growth rates. US stocks mixed as Iran tensions weigh, Anthropic outlook lifts tech stocks. As of 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 slipped 0.1 percent , the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.3 percent , and the Nasdaq Composite was virtually unchanged New Delhi Television inks deal to acquire GoodTimes channel. New Delhi Television has entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Lifestyle and Media Broadcasting (seller) for acquisition of the business undertaking comprising the GoodTimes channel (business undertaking) for a lump sum consideration of rupees 18 crore. Small caps steal the show as investors pile in. Investors are channeling significant funds into small and mid-cap stocks this fiscal year. Up over 110 percent in one year: Axis Direct sees another 10 percent upside in this multibagger stock. Axis Direct forecasts continued growth for CCL Products, setting a target price of rupees 1,245, citing strong Q1 performance, a solid balance sheet, and stable coffee prices. The stock shows significant gains, with a 550 percent increase since May 2020, supported by robust demand.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. REIT unitholder income grows: REIT income distribution doubles in one year to rupees 3,136 crore in Q1 FY27, number of listed trusts rises to six. India's six publicly listed Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) achieved remarkable results in Q1 FY27, doubling their distributions to a total of rupees 3,136 crore, which marks a 101 percent rise from the previous year. In addition to this significant financial milestone, the number of listed REITs grew from four to six, managing more than 214 million square feet of valuable real estate. Freelancers earning income from US IT companies: Key FAQs answered on tax calculation, TDS, GST and ITR filing. Indian freelancers earning from US IT companies need to correctly report income, convert dollar earnings, claim expenses, and comply with ITR, DTAA, GST, and foreign-income rules. Husband deposits his income in wife's bank account: Is she liable to pay tax? Here's what ITAT ruling says. A rupees 71.56 lakh cash deposit in a wife's bank account came under the tax department's scrutiny after she said the money was received from her husband. The Pune ITAT has now ruled on whether the same amount could be treated as unexplained income. Birth certificate for NRIs: Why this document matters more than ever. India's birth certificate has become an indispensable document for its citizens. Recent regulations stipulate that birth registrations are mandatory for obtaining passports and various services. This alteration especially affects Non-Resident Indians facing challenges with overseas births. Any delayed registrations will now necessitate approval from a judicial authority or magistrate. Reverse migration? Is cash finding its way back as currency with public surges to rupees 41.8 lakh crore?. At present UPI has nil charges, similar to cash transactions. However, if this changes and MDR charges are passed to customers, the public could shift towards cash. Already the margin between cash and UPI transactions is narrowing, as per a report. CGHS medical reimbursement rules clarified: What employees, pensioners need to know about rupees 3,000 limit. The CGHS has updated its regulations regarding beneficiary consultations and medical investigations. All follow-up treatments and tests costing up to rupees 3,000 should be done at the same facility. For investigations over rupees 3,000, prior referral from CGHS is necessary. Consultations are valid for a seven-day period within the same specialty. Foreign asset disclosure scheme 2026: How to calculate market value of different overseas holdings , check rules. The Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme 2026 allows eligible taxpayers to declare certain foreign assets and income. Valuing these assets correctly is important, with different rules for shares, bank accounts, property, and other assets. Apartment owners can't stop residents of another housing society from using common amenities if sale deed allows it, rules Karnataka HC. Apartment owners have no exclusive rights over common amenities if they signed sale deed containing a clause giving consent to sharing them with another housing society, rules Karnataka High Court. Read the article to know why the homeowners lost the case. Fact Check: Did PM Modi announce free 1-tola gold scheme on Independence Day? Here's what the PIB unit says. A viral video featuring PM Modi has been circulating on social media, claiming a free 1-tola gold for Aadhaar card holders. Here's what PIB Fact Check reveals about the alleged scheme and the authenticity of the viral video. Sale deed versus gift deed versus Will: Why witnesses matter differently for each. Do you need witnesses for a registered sale deed? Know what determines the validity of a registered sale deed. Know what the law says DA hike: BMS stages protest at Jantar Mantar to push demands , Minimum pension, OPS, labour codes on charter. The Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh protested in Delhi today, urging the government to address long-standing demands for employees, pensioners, and unorganised workers, including a minimum wage of rupees 30,000 and job security for contract workers. NRI life insurance protection plans can be 50–60 percent cheaper in India: Should you buy here or in your country of residence?. NRIs can buy life insurance in India to protect financial obligations. Additional KYC and underwriting requirements apply for non-resident Indians. Premiums are paid through NRE, NRO, or FCNR accounts, and currency fluctuations matter. Country of residence impacts premiums and underwriting due to risk assessments. Are Income plus arbitrage funds a good investment choice? Returns explained. After attracting nearly rupees 21,000 crore in 2025, income plus arbitrage funds saw investors withdraw around rupees 2,000 crore during the first seven months of 2026 through 31 July, according to MFI360 Explorer. Are NRIs taxed on money gifted to a Hindu Undivided Family?. The gift of money from your NRO bank account to your father's HUF will not create any tax liability for you, as a gift of money is not taxable in the hands of the person making the gift. Retired? 7 types of income that are taxable for senior citizens; know the rules. An uncommuted pension received after retirement is generally taxable as salary income in the hands of the retiree. UK based employee sold ESOP worth rupees 26 lakh, declared rupees 1 lakh short-term capital loss, Income Tax dept treated it as unexplained gains; He fights and wins case in ITAT Mumbai. UK-based Indian employee sold 1,540 L and T Infotech shares for rupees 26 lakh which he had acquired through ESOPs, declared rupees 1 lakh short-term capital loss; Tax dept treated it as rupees 29.59 lakh unexplained gains; ITAT Mumbai rules in employee's favour. Read the article to know why. Does becoming a loan guarantor affect your credit score? Key risks borrowers and guarantors should know. Becoming a loan guarantor can affect your credit score, borrowing capacity and financial stability if the borrower misses EMIs or defaults. Know the key risks, credit impact and precautions before signing a loan guarantee. Gold and silver returns in 2026: Key growth drivers and right allocation strategy for long-term investors. Gold and silver have taken different paths in 2026, shaped by changing global conditions and demand trends. While both retain a longer-term investment case, Tata MF's latest view points to some important differences investors may want to consider before deciding how to allocate. Bandhan Small Cap Fund made significant portfolio changes in July, adding 15 new stocks and exiting nine. HDFC Bank, AWL Agri Business and Sterlite Technologies were among the key stocks where the fund raised its holdings. Why feeling good is getting expensive. From concert tickets and weekend getaways to coffees, treats and office celebrations, "funflation" and "treatflation" are making small pleasures costlier, and quietly reshaping how we spend and save. ITR filing 2026: How freelancers and F and O traders should declare their income. Earning income from futures and options trading or other side hustles?
